name: Aman Venice
address: Calle Tiepolo 1364, Sestiere San Polo, Venice, Italy
tagline: Palazzo Papadopoli on the Grand Canal, with a private garden.
description:
Aman Venice occupies Palazzo Papadopoli, one of the eight monumental palazzos on the Grand Canal, a short walk from Piazza San Marco. Rococo frescoes and sculpture sit against the restrained interiors of Jean-Michel Gathy, and a private canal-side garden, rare in Venice, is part of the house.

The palazzo holds 16th-century Sansovino sculptures and Tiepolo frescoes within gallery-like rooms. Almost every room has views of the Grand Canal, and the frescoes and reliefs are by revered Italian artists. The grand ballroom and the piano nobile are used for dinners and events, and the hotel's staircase leads up through painted halls.

Rooms start at 47 square metres. The Palazzo Bedroom overlooks the gardens, the Chamber Affresco keeps original frescoes, and the Chamber Luminoso faces southeast. The Palazzo Stanzas Canal Grande range from 57 to 89 square metres, with views over the Grand Canal and the garden terrace. Signature rooms and apartments sit above them.

Arva is the main restaurant, serving what the hotel calls harvest cuisine: pastas, risottos, meats, seafood and cicchetti-inspired small plates, with Adriatic fish, Tuscan and Ligurian olive oils and produce from the lagoon. The Palazzo Kitchen Table seats eight around an open teppanyaki-style counter, where Executive Chef Matteo Panfilio serves a ten-course Veneto menu that mixes Italian and Japanese techniques. The Bar sits beneath an original Rotta fresco. From May to October the Grand Canal Garden serves meals from morning to dusk, with a fluted timber bar for aperitivo.

Aman Venice also has an intimate spa, offers a Sunday brunch paired with a spa treatment, and arranges private boat tours and gondola outings across the lagoon.

It suits travellers who want to sleep inside a Venetian palazzo with a garden, near San Marco but on the Grand Canal. The journey from Marco Polo Airport takes 50 minutes, including a water taxi from the mainland dock.
